findings.title: Sparse eras.json pads gap eras to empty Era_Row{} that era_row/era_advance_validate accept as valid advance targets
findings.evidence: `for len(cat.eras) < int(era) { append(&cat.eras, Era_Row{}) }` (catalog.odin:1243) + `if c.to_era == 0 || int(c.to_era) > len(cat.eras)` (era.odin:52) + era_row `if era == 0 || int(era) > len(cat.eras)` (catalog.odin:1351)
findings.detail: Rows {1,3} load clean; era 2 is a zero row that passes era_row and advance validation, so era_step fires state.era=2 with an empty roster and the director serves a possibly-empty padded demand row — a silent hollow era, against the fail-fast spirit. Latent: the shipped table is contiguous 1..3.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject non-contiguous era tables at load (each stored row's era == index+1 / era-numbered presence pass), or treat unpopulated rows as invalid targets in era_row/era_advance_validate.

findings.title: demand_era is validated at load but never read at runtime — the director keys demand.eras[state.era-1], so invariant (b) can check a different row than the one that spawns
findings.evidence: loader: `drow := &cat.demand.eras[de-1]` (catalog.odin:1232); runtime: `de := &cat.demand.eras[era-1]` (demand.odin:52) via `scripted_plan_demand(cat, state.era, tick)` (flow.odin:734); grep: Era_Row.demand_era read nowhere outside the loader
findings.detail: A row with demand_era != era passes load (invariant (b) validates the BOUND row) while the sim spawns the era-INDEXED row (never roster-checked) — invariant (b) can silently pass with a wrong served table. Shipped data has demand_era==era everywhere, so no live bug; the declared binding is decorative until enforced.
findings.recommended_fix: Pick one truth: enforce demand_era == era at load (one fail-fast row), or route the director through era_row(cat, era).demand_era.

findings.title: Load comment claims unique era ids but no id-uniqueness check exists
findings.evidence: `id`/`display_name` (non-empty, unique ids) (catalog.odin:1077) vs the only uniqueness guard `if seen[era-1] { return ... "duplicate era row" }` (era numbers only)
findings.detail: Two rows sharing an id load clean despite the documented uniqueness invariant. Contract-comment overclaim on a fail-fast catalog.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a linear id-uniqueness pass over parsed rows (map-free per ODN-10) or drop 'unique ids' from the comment.

findings.title: Demo lowering validates each advance only against the START era — duplicate/non-forward advance chains bless a replay_error log
findings.evidence: `if d.to_era <= demo.era { return ... not forward of the demo start era }` — per-intent check only; no running target across sorted advances
findings.detail: Two `advance 3` lines (or 3-then-4-then-3) pass lowering; at apply the second fails era_advance_validate and latches replay_error into the blessed log — the exact poisoned-log outcome the comment vows to prevent.
findings.recommended_fix: Track the running expected era across the sorted advance intents at lower time and reject any to_era not strictly forward of the previous target.

findings.title: Pipe-tier exact-equality invariant has no fail-fast row; node premature-listing direction also untested
findings.evidence: eras_rows covers packet both directions ('streaming listed in era 1', 'era-2 roster missing email') + node missing only ('era-2 unlock missing small_biz'); no pipe-tier invariant row exists; invariant (b) has the single builder row
findings.detail: The pipe-tier invariant loop (catalog.odin:1218-1228) is unpinned in both directions and the node premature-listing direction is unpinned — a regression there loads clean.
findings.recommended_fix: Add fail-fast rows: era-2 unlock missing a tier (missing direction) + a tier/node listed before its era (premature direction).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 100% (advance fires + demand switch, E14 deferral via a REAL engine crisis, replay identity fired AND deferred, invalid->replay_error, invariants mutation-checked). P1 gaps: pipe-tier invariant directions, Cmd_Era_Advance unit roundtrip, harness advance-verb negative paths. Orchestrator mutation-checks independently confirmed the E14 gate + packet missing-roster direction are non-vacuous.
findings.recommended_fix: Close the P1 gaps above to raise the gate to PASS.

findings.title: era_step takes cat but never uses it; the seam comment claims it 'loads the new era's unlocks'
findings.evidence: era_step body touches only state (latch check, era_advance_blocked(state), state.era = new_era, event_emit_era(state,...)); cat unread
findings.detail: Dead parameter + an overclaiming comment ('loads the unlocks' — the unlocks are pure catalog queries). Cosmetic.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the cat parameter or assert era_row(cat, new_era); fix the 'loads the unlocks' wording.

findings.title: Demand-switch test hardcodes streaming's class index (e.class == 1) instead of resolving it
findings.evidence: `if e.class == 1 { found_streaming = true }` — while the same file resolves indices via class_index everywhere else
findings.detail: A packet_types.json reorder flips the assertion to a false pass/fail. Test-only brittleness.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve si via class_index(cat, "streaming") and compare e.class == si.

findings.title: Era domain documented as both 1..6 and 1..64 within the same change
findings.evidence: `1..6 fits a u8` (event_emit_era comment) vs `era must be in 1..64` (loader)
findings.detail: Both fit a u8 — documentation drift only; the 1..6 claim goes stale when eras 4-6+ land.
findings.recommended_fix: State the real bound (u8 payload covers the catalog's 1..64 domain).

findings.title: A missing demand_era key reports 'has no demand.json row' instead of 'missing field'
findings.evidence: jint_strict returns (def, true) on absent key (catalog.odin:1428) -> de=0 -> 'demand_era 0 has no demand.json row'; the catalog_test row 'demand_era missing' pins this message
findings.detail: Misleading rejection for a missing field, now blessed by the test. Fail-fast ergonomics only.
findings.recommended_fix: Distinguish absent-key from out-of-range and emit 'demand_era is required' for the former.

findings.title: PR body says '20 new fail-fast rows'; the test adds 22 rejection assertions
findings.evidence: 21 eras_rows table entries + 1 invariant-(b) builder row = 22 vs '**`core/catalog_test.odin`** (20 new fail-fast rows)'
findings.detail: Prose/count mismatch only — actual coverage EXCEEDS the claim. No AC governs the count.
findings.recommended_fix: Update the PR body to the true count.

findings.title: PR body omits the required ODN-16 citation (Acceptance #4)
findings.evidence: briefing Acceptance #4: 'citations (ODN-16, ODN-5, E14, stories-v2 6.1)'; grep -c ODN-16 pr-bodies/6.1.md = 0 (ODN-5/E14/stories-v2 6.1 all present)
findings.detail: Acceptance #4 names four mandatory citations; the story's own system tag ODN-16 (Era FSM S6) appears nowhere in the shipped PR body.
findings.recommended_fix: Cite ODN-16 where the PR body introduces the S6 Era FSM.

findings.title: No unit binary roundtrip test for Cmd_Era_Advance (every prior command tag has one)
findings.evidence: grep: no Cmd_Era_Advance/ERA_ADVANCE in determinism_test.odin; only era_test.odin references the command
findings.detail: Tag-7 serialization is covered end-to-end by the era_advance golden replay (incl. the drift bad_era row) but lacks the unit roundtrip every prior tag has.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a log_write/log_read roundtrip row carrying Cmd_Era_Advance.

findings.title: Advance pending on the terminal tick is untested
findings.evidence: era_test.odin holds 6 tests; none latches terminal with an advance pending (era_step precedes win_lose_eval within a tick; the E17 barrier only gates later ticks)
findings.detail: Boundary between the S6 seam and the terminal barrier unpinned; current order is correct by inspection.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a test: advance latched on the tick win_lose_eval fires; assert one terminal event and the documented era behavior.

findings.title: era_advance_validate to_era=0 boundary and the documented last-write-wins double-latch are untested
findings.evidence: invalid-requests test covers to_era==current and era 5 (out of table) only; no to_era=0 row; no double-latch test
findings.detail: Two documented behaviors (zero rejection, LWW) unpinned.
findings.recommended_fix: Add both rows to the invalid-requests/latch tests.

findings.title: Harness `advance` verb fail-loud paths (parse + lower-time validation) have no negative coverage
findings.evidence: three new error paths ('bad advance era', era-not-in-table, non-forward) exercised only on the happy path by era_advance.dem
findings.detail: Harness-side negative coverage gap; the blessed log's integrity depends on these rejections.
findings.recommended_fix: Add parse/lower rejection cases to the harness test path.

findings.title: era_record_run is a fifth near-copy of the step-collect-hash loop
findings.evidence: record_run/crisis_record_run/sla_record_run/warn_record_run/health_record_run (determinism/crisis/sla/warnings/health tests) + era_record_run — same shape; the resume-from-tick delta (start := s.tick + 1) is never exercised from a mid-run state
findings.detail: Test-only duplication the codebase already tolerates; the untested resume delta is the only new risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: fold into a shared helper; or drop the resume delta until a caller needs it.
